2608.28361.title: GRACE:Gradient-guided Coreset Selection for LLM Unlearning
2608.28361.paper_summary: Machine Unlearning methods for Large Language Models typically assume pre-specified forget and retain sets. In realistic settings, however, requests may provide only a few examples of undesired behavior, requiring forget and retain sets to be inferred from heterogeneous corpora. We study this data-selection problem and propose GRACE , a gradient-guided coreset selection method that constructs both forget and retain sets for LLM unlearning. GRACE first computes a forget direction from seed examples that elicit the undesired behavior, then selects a compact forget coreset whose gradients approximate this direction using non-negative orthogonal matching pursuit. To preserve model utility, it selects retain examples after projecting out the forget direction and applying clustered orthogonal matching pursuit in the remaining gradient space. Across two target domains, two model families, and four unlearning algorithms, GRACE improves model utility while maintaining comparable forget quality, with particularly consistent gains over prior gradient-based selection methods.
2608.28361.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型的機器遺忘方法通常假設預先指定的遺忘和保留集合。然而，在現實情況下，請求可能僅提供少量不希望出現行為的例子，這需要從異質語料庫中推斷遺忘和保留集合。我們研究了這個數據選擇問題，並提出了GRACE，一種梯度引導的核心集選擇方法，該方法為LLM的遺忘構建了遺忘和保留集合。GRACE首先從引發不希望行為的種子例子中計算遺忘方向，然後選擇一個緊湊的遺忘核心集，其梯度使用非負正交匹配追蹤來近似該方向。為了保護模型效用，它在投影出遺忘方向並在剩餘的梯度空間中應用聚類正交匹配追蹤後選擇保留例子。在兩個目標領域、兩個模型系列和四個遺忘算法中，GRACE在保持可比的遺忘質量的同時改善了模型效用，並在之前的基於梯度的選擇方法上特別一致地獲得了增益。
